description: What a home battery saves a year and over its life, and a sensible size by the Verbraucherzentrale rule of thumb. Uses the same model as the calculator in Sky Solar's guide. An illustration, not a quote.

consumptionKwh.description: Electricity the household uses, kWh a year

locale.description: Language of the answer: de (German) or en (English).

priceCt.description: Price paid for grid electricity, ct/kWh (default 32, an assumption)

shiftedKwh.description: kWh a year the battery moves from midday to the evening. Default 1,500: the Verbraucherzentrale example for a home battery

tariffCt.description: Feed-in payment the system gets, ct/kWh. Default: today's rate for new systems up to 10 kWp. Older systems often get more

name: battery_savings
title: Battery savings
